fixedChain.realBusiness: controlled Work -> Broker question -> answer -> native_applied -> accept -> delivered
fixedChain.candidate: real SDK candidate plus confirmed proposal receipt and original context token
fixedChain.permissionQa: anchored trusted_user plus question_answer_display, never ordinary model input

actualDiagnostics.default: old shape with no scopeReview key
actualDiagnostics.authorityUnchanged: state, body release, principal and original binding remain authoritative; diagnostics change neither
actualDiagnostics.strictQuery: 400 for 0, empty, repeated, true, or extra query parameters
actualDiagnostics.noPrivateData: no principal, readable counts or raw paths in the public diagnostic

invalidations.originalReceipts: confirmed proposal token and original context token replay both 422
invalidations.frozenBody: audit bundleDigest equals the source binding and is not replaced by live sources
invalidations.permissionQa: display text absent from frozen sources

v1.reads: verified sources, Work delivered, delivery native_applied

v2.newRisk: v2 through the standard entry (v1 standard/reuse and v2 demo retained from wave21)

projectionBoundary.authority: main guard remains the only release rule
projectionBoundary.unknownCounts: null when unobserved; not exposed in the public DTO
projectionBoundary.moduleOnly: no SQL, HTTP writer, confirmation authority or LLM loop

consumerRules.D: run the driver from the real install root; report actual entry hashes and its own package subject
consumerRules.E: bind the driver output to the same package consumer bytes before calling it installed; source checkout never certifies an old package
consumerRules.notReached: a package entry without the state/port/api-port/discussion-only/review flags must fail explicitly, not fall back to the source demo

limitations: executed entries are start.mjs and demo.ts; D launcher was not run
restore is a real v1/v2 database/artifacts copy plus a personal-restore/1 marker, not the full install/upgrade matrix
validity case reflects frozen binding expiresAt versus the current selection, not a live revocation timer
no private permission, target startup, queue consumption or vendor native turn
